subject: Polaris Health: Sales → Success transition and 30d Kickstart
messages:
From: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Sophie Reynolds <sophie@polarishealth.com>, Raj Patel <raj.patel@polarishealth.com>, procurement@polarishealth.com
Date: 2026-08-22T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Polaris Health: Sales → Success transition and 30d Kickstart

Team —

Great to have Polaris Health across the line. Quick context up front so CS/ops can start planning:

- Contract: 12-month hosted inference subscription; committed monthly tokens + 2-week staging window.
- Primary contacts: Sophie Reynolds (Clinical Ops), Raj Patel (Platform/IT), procurement@polarishealth.com (PO).
- Key dates: staging begins 2026-09-06, production go-live target 2026-09-20.
- Scope: embedding + chat for clinical triage workflows; data residency: US; need audit logs retention 18 months.
- Initial models: recommended open Llama-2.1-Chat quantized variant (we discussed fallback to a smaller variant for burst handling).
- Estimated volume: 30M tokens/mo first 60 days (burst on weekdays).

Known blockers / dependencies:
1) Customer to provide API allowlist IPs and VPC peering details (see questionnaire).
2) Procurement will issue PO before go-live.
3) SOC2 evidence and subprocessor list requested — attached first pass.

Attachments: Polaris_SOW_Draft_v1.pdf (SOW draft), Implementation_Questionnaire.xlsx (network + auth).

Asks:
- Marissa & Grace: please confirm CS owner and initial cadence (I propose twice-weekly for first 30 days).
- Ben / Tessa: can you confirm staging resource requirements and whether we need a dedicated pool?
- Vivek: any SLA exceptions or credit approvals needed for this customer?

I'll host a 30-minute kickoff with customer + CS next Tue (2026-08-24) if that works for everyone — propose 10:00am PT.

Thanks,
Michael Grant
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

--

Thanks Michael — excited to partner on this.

I will be CS lead for the first 30 days and will nominate a primary steward: Grace O'Connor (cc'd below). Grace, can you pick up technical onboarding coordination and confirm initial weekly cadence? I suggest:
- Twice-weekly operational sync for week 1-2 (Mon/Wed 30m)
- Weekly thereafter through day 60

Grace: immediate asks from CS perspective — please confirm:
- Which internal engineer will own network peering and API allowlist (Ben/Tessa?)
- Whether we need a dedicated Dedicated pool request or we can use burst capacity. If dedicated, what's the minimum commit timeline?

I'll set the kickoff for Tue 2026-08-24 10:00am PT unless someone flags a conflict.

Marissa Cole
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Sophie Reynolds <sophie@polarishealth.com>
Date: 2026-08-23T08:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Polaris Health: Sales → Success transition and 30d Kickstart

Quick tech notes from my side — pulled from the pre-sales runbook and our PoC: 

1) Network: customer prefers outbound-only connections from our hosted runtime; they will not permit inbound peering. We need the allowlist of outbound egress IPs and to confirm we can route through our shared-edge (no VPC peering).
2) Models & quantization: Llama-2.1-Chat quantized (8-bit) will meet accuracy targets; recommend a fallback to a gpt-small-like variant for mid-day bursts to stay within latency SLOs.
3) Staging capacity: suggest a 2x burst allowance for first 14 days; if we use Dedicated, minimum reserve is 1 month notice — ops cost impact TBD.
4) Logging & retention: 18 months retention for audit logs is fine but will need config for export to customer S3 (they asked).

I've attached a lightweight architecture diagram (arch-diagram.png) to show how the staging will flow through shared-edge -> runtime pool -> metrics export.

Proposed mutual action plan (high level):
- 8/24: Kickoff (confirm owner + runbook)
- 8/25-9/03: Network allowlist + credentials + staging validation
- 9/06: Start staging window (2 weeks)
- 9/20: Target production go-live

Grace — I'm happy to join the kickoff to walk through runbook and production cutover checklist.

Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

--
Attachment stub: arch-diagram.png (PNG, 46KB)

Thanks, team — appreciate the clear plan. A few quick items from our side: 

1) PO: procurement will issue PO_8743 by end of day Friday 8/27 — I will upload the signed PDF once it's processed.
2) DocuSign: can you send the final SOW link? We reviewed the draft and have two small redlines (commercial, not technical).
3) SOC2 & subprocessor list: Raj asked for SOC2 Type II report and subprocessor list; if possible, share links or a secure download.
4) Kickoff: 8/24 10:00am PT works for clinical + platform. Please include an invite with dial-in and agenda.

Sophie Reynolds
Head of Clinical Operations, Polaris Health
